title: Loan Accounting Note: Interest Accrual and Installment Billing on Farm Real Estate Loans
content:
Interest on every Farm Real Estate Loans mortgage accrues daily on the principal balance using the actual/365 day count.

## Billing of each installment

- **Installment period.** On each due date the interest for the installment period — the day after the previous due date (the closing date for the first installment) through the due date — is booked and billed with that installment.
- **Amount and rounding.** The interest for the period is the sum, over each calendar day of the period (first and last day included), of the end-of-day principal balance, multiplied by the annual rate and divided by 365, rounded once to cents.
- **Next due date.** The next due date moves by one installment period: one, six or twelve calendar months according to the installment frequency (monthly, semiannual or annual), falling back to the last day of a shorter month.
- **Rate change inside a period.** When the rate changes inside a period, the period is booked as two accrual entries split at the change date.
- **What is due.** The installment due is the loan's installment amount, of which the billed interest is the interest share; the final installment is the billed interest plus all principal outstanding.
- **Product terms read.** The installment frequencies allowed, the default-interest add-on and the default-interest trigger days of each FarmLand product are those of the product schedules.

## Clause no longer in force

> The clause "While an installment is past due more than the product's default-interest trigger days, counted in calendar days, principal accrues at the contract rate plus the default-interest add-on, booked as default-rate interest, from the day after that threshold until the day every past-due installment is paid." is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for default-rate interest entries.

## Worked illustration (hypothetical)

A semiannual installment falls due on 15 July 2026; the previous installment fell due on 15 January 2026. The installment period runs from 16 January through 15 July 2026, 181 calendar days. With the end-of-day principal balance steady at USD 500000 and a contract rate of 7.000 percent:

- the sum of end-of-day balances is 500000 times 181, that is USD 90500000;
- multiplied by 7 percent that is 6335000, and divided by 365 it is 17356.164;
- rounded once to cents, the interest billed is USD 17356.16.

If the rate had changed on 1 May 2026 inside that period, the period would be booked as two accrual entries split at that change date.

**Month-end fallback (hypothetical).** A monthly installment due on 31 January 2026 is followed by one due on 28 February 2026, February having no 31st day.

superseded_clauses: While an installment is past due more than default_interest_trigger_days calendar days, principal accrues at the contract rate plus default_interest_addon_pct, booked with rate_basis default_rate, from the day after that threshold until the day every past-due installment is paid.
